a.lede: Under the interim rule, the U.S. will require firms to get licenses to export AI chips if they may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.
a.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely

b.lede: The Bureau of Industry and Security has announced a new interim final rule to ensure restrictions on the export of physical AI hardware cannot be bypassed by accessing it remotely in data centers around the world.
b.title: New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure
